command.name: Shadowflame
command.verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy within adjacency (Damage Rate: +125%). Additionally, there is a 20% chance to afflict the target with Burn (Damage Rate: +20%) for 2 round(s).

vanguard.name: Warrior's Zeal
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Physical Damage (Active Commands and Habits) Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Instill Fear
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 50% chance to reduce Intelligence and Instinct by -25% (enhanced by Strength) and afflict Panic (Damage Rate: +20%) on 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank). Each effect lasts for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Powerful Reflexes
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Strength and Initiative by +27.2% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Shroud of Shadows
habits.verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: 30% chance to afflict Confusion on 1 Enemy within adjacency for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Darkening Fear
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 25% chance to reduce Intelligence and Instinct by -25% (enhanced by Strength) and afflict Panic (Damage Rate: +20%) on 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank). Each effect lasts for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Phantom's Veil
habits.verbatim: Start of Each Round Reduce either your Physical, Tactical, OR Fire Damage Received by -15% until the end of the round.
